# TECHNAVIA

> TECHNAVIA (technaviatechnology.com) is a B2B web engineering, Technical SEO, LLM Visibility (AEO/GEO), and Custom AI Automation studio based in Surat, Gujarat, India serving global clients — distinct from Technavio market research.

We engineer sub-second Next.js websites built to rank on Google, get cited by ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity, and automate B2B lead pipelines. Contact: inquiry@technaviatechnology.com.

## Core Engineering Services

- [Web Development + Technical SEO](https://technaviatechnology.com/services/web-development-seo): Next.js App Router engineering with 100/100 Core Web Vitals, sub-400ms LCP, React 19 Server Components, and connected Schema.org JSON-LD entity graphs.
- [LLM Visibility (AEO / GEO)](https://technaviatechnology.com/services/llm-visibility): Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) structuring entity graphs and quotable answer-capsules so ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity cite and recommend your brand.
- [Custom AI Automations](https://technaviatechnology.com/services/ai-automations): Production n8n, Python, and CRM sync automations that enrich firmographics, score ICP leads, and sync HubSpot or Salesforce in under 60 seconds.

## Proof Builds & Case Studies

- [Seravolve](https://technaviatechnology.com/results/seravolve): Production D2C skincare e-commerce build with +64% quiz-to-checkout conversion, sub-1.0s LCP, custom 3-step quiz engine, and routine builder.
- [TG media](https://technaviatechnology.com/results/tg-media): High-speed digital platform and conversion architecture with +310% pipeline engagement, 95+ Core Web Vitals, and 42s automated lead triage bus.
- [COSMO SOLOR](https://technaviatechnology.com/results/cosmo-solor): Renewable solar energy web system engineered for search visibility with +185% inquiry surge, sub-0.6s LCP, and Schema entity graph.
